title: Perdezh - Fart mod
description: This mod adds farts. A fart charge bar, fart power levels, toxic clouds, launches, and explosions.
body: **Perdezh** is a chaotic mod that adds a fully charged fart system to Minecraft. Your gas builds up over time and from eating food, letting you unleash everything from small harmless puffs to powerful blasts that launch you up, poison enemies, ignite the area, break blocks, and create pure nonsense. It also includes a fart bar, fart sounds, poop and poop grenades, many config options, and a bunch of silly advancements.
